title: In Psalms 24 In What Ways Can We Recognize And Honor God As The King Of Glory In Our Daily Lives
paragraphs: Recognizing and Honoring God as the King of Glory: Insights from Psalm 24

Psalm 24 stands as a majestic hymn that proclaims God’s kingship and invites His people to recognize and honor Him as the “King of Glory.” This psalm not only celebrates God’s sovereign rule over the earth but also instructs believers on how to respond to His glory in daily living. Let’s explore how we can practically recognize and honor God as the King of Glory, drawing from the rich truths of this psalm.
1. Acknowledge God’s Sovereignty Over All Creation
Psalm 24 opens with a profound declaration of God’s ownership and authority:
The earth is Jehovah’s, and the fulness thereof; The world, and they that dwell therein. -
Psalm 24:1 ASV

Recognizing God as the Creator and rightful owner of all things shapes our daily perspective. Every resource, relationship, and opportunity belongs to Him. Honoring God involves living with the awareness that our lives are not our own, but are entrusted to us for His purposes (1 Corinthians 6:19-20 ASV).
2. Pursue Holiness and Integrity
The psalmist asks, “Who shall ascend into the hill of Jehovah? And who shall stand in his holy place?” and answers:
He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; Who hath not lifted up his soul unto falsehood, And hath not sworn deceitfully. -
Psalm 24:4 ASV

Honoring the King of Glory means pursuing personal holiness. “Clean hands” represent right actions, and a “pure heart” reflects right motives. In daily life, this calls us to integrity in our work, relationships, and worship. It also means repenting quickly and seeking God’s cleansing when we fall short (1 John 1:9 ASV).
3. Seek God’s Presence and Favor
Those who seek God’s face receive His blessing:
He shall receive a blessing from Jehovah, And righteousness from the God of his salvation. -
Psalm 24:5 ASV

Honoring God as King means prioritizing His presence through prayer, worship, and Scripture. Like the generation described in verse 6, we are called to be those “that seek after him, That seek thy face.” This daily pursuit reminds us that God’s favor and approval are of utmost value.
4. Welcome Christ, the King of Glory, Into Every Area of Life
The psalm climaxes with a call to open the gates for the King of Glory:
Lift up your heads, O ye gates; And be ye lifted up, ye everlasting doors: And the King of glory will come in. -
Psalm 24:7 ASV

This prophetic language is often understood to point ultimately to Jesus Christ, who is the “King of Glory” entering Jerusalem and the hearts of His people (John 12:13 ASV). Each day, we honor Him by yielding every area of life—our thoughts, plans, and desires—to His rule. This is a call to surrender and to invite Christ to reign in our homes, workplaces, and communities.
5. Proclaim His Glory to Others

Psalm 24 is a public declaration of God’s greatness. Honoring God as King means making His glory known to others—through acts of service, words of testimony, and living lives that reflect His character (Matthew 5:16 ASV).
Conclusion: Living Daily for the King of Glory

Recognizing and honoring God as the King of Glory is not reserved for special occasions—it is a daily calling. We honor Him by acknowledging His sovereignty, living with purity, seeking His presence, surrendering our lives, and proclaiming His glory. As Psalm 24 reminds us, the King of Glory is worthy of our wholehearted devotion and praise.
